translations.web: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
translations.bsb: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on this day.
translations.kjv: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
translations.asv: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any manner of work in that same day, that soul will I destroy from among his people.
